Dragons 1.2.6 - more wild dragons, shared eggs

Wild dragons
- Your own tamed dragons no longer stop wild dragons from spawning around you. Before, a dragon following you blocked almost every spawn nearby.
- In forests and jungles, where a big dragon has no room between the trees, wild dragons now spawn on the treetops or in a clearing nearby, so Thorn Wyrms are much easier to find.

Eggs
- When two players' dragons breed, both players can pick up the egg.
- An egg belongs to whoever places it, so you can give an egg to a friend: pick it up, hand it over, and the dragon that hatches is theirs.

Thanks for the reports!
